cards.name: Aluminium alloy 6061-T6
cards.standard: Aluminum Association alloy 6061, temper T6 (specification minima of ASTM B209/B221 not read)
cards.condition: temper T6, room temperature (68-77 degF where stated); typical values of the Aluminum Association quoted by a supplier's datasheet, which marks them as not for design; elongation for 1.6 mm (1/16 in.) thickness

E_MPa.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651' (PDF on aerospacemetals.com, no edition or date), mechanical properties: modulus of elasticity 68.9 GPa, AA typical, average of tension and compression

nu.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', mechanical properties: Poisson's ratio 0.33, stated as estimated from trends in similar Al alloys

density_kg_m3.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', physical properties: density 2.7 g/cc, AA typical

yield_MPa.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', mechanical properties: tensile yield strength 276 MPa, AA typical (not a guaranteed minimum)

tensile_MPa.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', mechanical properties: ultimate tensile strength 310 MPa, AA typical

elongation_pct.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', mechanical properties: elongation at break 12 % for 1/16 in. (1.6 mm) thickness, AA typical (17 % for 1/2 in. diameter)

fatigue_limit_MPa.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', mechanical properties: fatigue strength 96.5 MPa at 500,000,000 cycles, completely reversed stress, RR Moore machine/specimen (AA)

thermal_conductivity_W_mK.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', thermal properties: thermal conductivity 167 W/m-K at 77 degF, AA typical

specific_heat_J_kgK.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', thermal properties: specific heat capacity 0.896 J/g-degC (no note on the row); 896 J/(kg K) is the unit conversion

thermal_expansion_per_K.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', thermal properties: CTE linear 23.6 um/m-degC, AA typical, average over 68-212 degF

resistivity_ohm_m.source: secondary: ASM Aerospace Specification Metals datasheet 'Aluminum 6061-T6; 6061-T651', electrical properties: electrical resistivity 3.99e-006 ohm-cm at 68 degF, AA typical; 3.99e-08 ohm m is the unit conversion

cards.name: Property class 8.8 bolt steel (ISO 898-1)
cards.name_ja: 強度区分 8.8 のボルト用鋼 (ISO 898-1)
cards.condition: bolts, screws and studs of property class 8.8, nominal diameter d <= 16 mm, machined test pieces, tested at ambient temperature (10 degC to 35 degC); for d > 16 mm the standard's minima are higher (Rm 830 MPa, Rp0.2 660 MPa)

tensile_MPa.source: ISO 898-1:2013(E), 4th edition, Table 3 No. 1 (tensile strength Rm, minimum, class 8.8, d <= 16 mm); read in the publisher's free sample PDF (iTeh, pp. 8-9)

yield_MPa.source: ISO 898-1:2013(E), Table 3 No. 3 (stress at 0.2 % non-proportional elongation Rp0.2, minimum, class 8.8, d <= 16 mm; the standard gives no lower yield strength ReL for 8.8); read in the iTeh sample PDF, pp. 8-9

elongation_pct.source: ISO 898-1:2013(E), Table 3 No. 6 (percentage elongation after fracture A of machined test pieces, minimum, class 8.8); read in the iTeh sample PDF, pp. 8-9

max_service_degC.source: ISO 898-1:2013(E), Clause 1 Scope, Note 1 (informative, not a requirement): such fasteners are used from -50 degC to +150 degC, and outside that range a fastener metallurgist should be consulted (up to +300 degC); the upper end is taken here as the maximum service temperature; read in the iTeh sample PDF, p. 1

cards.name: Annealed copper conductor of electric wire (International Annealed Copper Standard)
cards.name_ja: 電線の軟銅導体 (万国標準軟銅)
cards.standard: International Annealed Copper Standard (IACS, 100 % conductivity), as stated in NBS Handbook 100
cards.condition: annealed copper of 100 % IACS conductivity at 20 degC; the standard's defined reference values, not minima of a wire standard (JIS C 3102 not read); mechanical and thermal-conduction properties not found in a source read

resistivity_ohm_m.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: volume resistivity of the International Annealed Copper Standard 0.017241 ohm mm2/m (1.7241 microhm cm) at 20 degC, a defined reference value; 1.7241e-08 ohm m is the unit conversion

density_kg_m3.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: density of the International Annealed Copper Standard taken as 8.89 g/cm3 at 20 degC (a defined value)

thermal_expansion_per_K.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: coefficient of linear expansion 0.000017 per degC (at 20 degC) of the International Annealed Copper Standard

cards.name: HDPE (high-density polyethylene), molded
cards.name_ja: 高密度ポリエチレン (成形品)
cards.condition: generic molded HDPE at room temperature (the fender of the demo vehicle); E_MPa, nu and yield_MPa are the values hiraku/designgen/ladder_4w.py (HDPE) uses; density and specific heat are a supplier's generic HDPE values; the grade of the fender is not chosen

E_MPa.source: hiraku/designgen/ladder_4w.py (HDPE): a round value of the order of HDPE's; lies inside the tensile modulus range 0.5-1.2 GPa listed for generic HDPE by Goodfellow (product page 'HDPE Granules', code ET32-GL-000110, secondary, no test method), which does not give one value

nu.source: secondary: Goodfellow product page 'HDPE Granules' (code ET32-GL-000110), property list, Poisson's ratio 0.46 for generic HDPE; the same as hiraku/designgen/ladder_4w.py (HDPE) since the analysis department's change

density_kg_m3.source: secondary: Goodfellow product page 'HDPE Granules' (code ET32-GL-000110), property list, 0.95 g/cm3 for generic HDPE; the same as hiraku/designgen/ladder_4w.py (HDPE)

yield_MPa.source: hiraku/designgen/ladder_4w.py (HDPE): a round value of the order of HDPE's; lies inside the tensile strength range 15-40 MPa Goodfellow lists for generic HDPE (a range of tensile strength, not a yield value); not read as such in a source

specific_heat_J_kgK.source: secondary: Goodfellow product page 'HDPE Granules' (code ET32-GL-000110), property list, specific heat 1900 J/(K kg) for generic HDPE, no test method

cards.name: PVC insulation of automotive low-voltage cable (AVSS thin-wall type)
cards.name_ja: 自動車用低圧電線の PVC 絶縁体 (AVSS 薄肉形)
cards.standard: JASO D 611 (AVSS); the standard's text not read
cards.condition: PVC insulation of AVSS cable (JASO D 611 thin-wall, nominal insulation thickness 0.3 mm for 0.3 to 1.25 mm2); other cable types (AVS, CAVS, heat-resistant AVSSX/AVSSH) have other ratings and are not covered

max_service_degC.source: secondary: the cable's heat-resistance class of 80 degC (AVSS, all sizes), stated on Allied Wire & Cable 'AVSS Wire' page (cites JASO D625/D609), RR Kabel 'AVSS - Ultra Thin Wall PVC Insulation' page (-40 degC to +80 degC, cites JASO D 611) and Dongguan Wenchang AVSS page (cites JASO D 611); the pages are undated; no datasheet of Sumitomo, Yazaki, Furukawa or Fujikura was opened; the rated class is taken as the maximum service temperature (the schema has no kind for a rating)

cards.name: JIS G 3101 SS400 (rolled steel for general structure, thickness up to 16 mm)
cards.name_ja: 一般構造用圧延鋼材 SS400 (厚さ 16 mm 以下)
cards.standard: JIS G 3101 (2024 edition as cited by the secondary source)
cards.condition: SS400 plate, strip, flat bar and sections, thickness up to 16 mm, room temperature; elongation for 5 mm < t <= 16 mm with No. 1A test piece (t <= 5 mm: 21 % with No. 5 test piece); E, nu and density are common carbon-steel design values not read in a source

E_MPa.source: secondary: MLIT (Japan) building-works structural design document, chapter 4, table 4.2.1 (material constants), p. 4-3, https://www.mlit.go.jp/gobuild/content/001517904.pdf; the same document's table 4.1.1 names the steel as SS400 (JIS G 3101); it does not name the standard its constants come from; E = 2.05e5 N/mm2

nu.source: secondary: MLIT (Japan) building-works structural design document, chapter 4, table 4.2.1 (material constants), p. 4-3, https://www.mlit.go.jp/gobuild/content/001517904.pdf; the same document's table 4.1.1 names the steel as SS400 (JIS G 3101); it does not name the standard its constants come from; nu = 0.3

density_kg_m3.source: data/materials/materials.json; not read for SS400 (EN 1993-1-1 / EN 1991-1-1 Table A.4 give about 7850 for structural steel in general, read on eurocodeapplied.com, secondary, 2026-11-06: not this steel)

yield_MPa.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), section 201 'ippan kozo-yo atsuen kozai (SS)', following JIS G 3101:2024, table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 yield point or proof stress min 245 N/mm2 for t <= 16 mm

tensile_MPa.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 tensile strength 400 to 510 N/mm2; the lower bound is the value here

elongation_pct.source: secondary: Tokyo Metropolitan Government, Bureau of Construction, materials specification (000063094.pdf), table 201-3(2), p. 57: SS400 elongation min 17 % for 5 mm < t <= 16 mm, No. 1A test piece (21 % for t <= 5 mm, No. 5 test piece)
